blocks.text: A Zustand store groups values and actions. create returns a React hook that components can use to read that store.
Use a React project with Zustand 5 installed. Hook examples belong in React components; vanilla examples use zustand/vanilla. These package imports require your own build tool.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Create the store outside a component for this shared client example. Creating it on every render would lose the intended shared instance.
